purpose: Close the Indian Ocean cross-theater gate using the reconstructed combat-air and ASW-air capability bands, named submarine catch-up, actual Eastern Fleet movement, and the Andaman-Arakan observation network.
adjudication_method: Use dated historical movement when Branch-compatible.
Use capability bands for readiness/tasking, not false exact counts.
cue != track != maintained datum != weapon-quality contact.
No strike or reinforcement gate opens from inference alone.

chronology.RN_state: Queen Elizabeth/Valiant/Renown heavy group remains in Ceylon workup/training cycle; no Bay/Andaman combat sortie.
chronology.Japan_air: 705th maritime search remains within 4-8 sorties/24h capability band; 5th Air Division is not diverted from Bengal/Arakan without a fleet cue.
chronology.subwar: I-166 attacks British Fusilier and misses.
chronology.contact_result: No Japanese weapon-quality track on an Eastern Fleet major force.
chronology.decision: Second Japanese western surface reinforcement remains HOLD.

chronology.RN_state: Gambia arrives Trincomalee and becomes available to Eastern Fleet. Heavy units remain escort-constrained.
chronology.air_state: Ceylon land-based maritime search continues; Illustrious operational squadrons are still treated shore-based for immediate carrier-launch accounting.
chronology.decision: Oyodo group remains Singapore/Lingga rear-mobile reserve; no forward dash to Port Blair/Sabang.

chronology.RN_state: Tromp sails Trincomalee to Colombo for docking/self-refit. No eastbound battle-fleet sortie.
chronology.air_state: No Japanese strike is released against Ceylon; 331st remains local-defense capable and 705th search does not mature into a maintained datum.
chronology.asw_state: Western Tokai detachment performs routine priority-lane sweep/datum readiness only; no Allied submarine datum exists to convert into attack. Ka-go local presence remains zero.

chronology.RN_state: Operation SLEUTH sails from Trincomalee: Illustrious + Gambia + Rotherham + Tjerk Hiddes, heading toward the Cocos-area search zone rather than the Bay of Bengal/Andaman axis.
chronology.carrier_air: 15 Wing Corsairs re-embark. Illustrious is allowed its reconstructed embarked first-window capability band (27-36 mission-ready total; 10-14 Barracuda strike/search and 8-14 fighter CAP/escort subject to deck cycle), with no duplicate shore credit.
chronology.Japan_search: 705th/Andaman-Sumatra search system generates no weapon-quality contact on SLEUTH by 22T24. RO-111 does not obtain a usable recontact. I-37 is far to the west near the Addu lane and sinks British Chivalry, which does not cue SLEUTH.
chronology.Japan_surface: Oyodo + Teruzuki + Takanami + Makinami + Kiyonami do not sortie. The force is held for fresh contact/night exploitation and not exposed on a speculative chase.
chronology.Japan_air_strike: NONE. No fresh contact exists for 705th anti-shipping release; 5th Air Division and 331st are not converted into long-range anti-carrier strike strength.
chronology.asw_state: Tokai/MAD western detachment continues routine lane protection; I-162 departure from Penang benefits from covered-lane risk reduction but no Allied submarine contact/attack occurs in this event window. Ka-go contribution = 0.
chronology.contact_result: Japanese operational intelligence may infer increased RN activity only after delayed reporting; same-day force composition/track remains LOW confidence.

event_outcome.Japanese_submarine_shipping_result: I-166 miss on 19 Feb; I-37 sinks British Chivalry on 22 Feb; no contact with SLEUTH
event_outcome.Tokai_effect: routine covered-lane risk reduction only; no kill/mission-kill claim

cross_theater_reconciliation.Central_Pacific: No additional CL/DD/carrier debit. Existing Oyodo + four-DD western allocation remains booked.
cross_theater_reconciliation.Bengal_Arakan: No emergency diversion of the 5th Air Division from land-support/air-defense tasks.
cross_theater_reconciliation.Allied: Illustrious sortie creates a real carrier availability commitment away from Ceylon after departure; do not simultaneously count its embarked squadrons as Ceylon shore strength.
cross_theater_reconciliation.result: Indian Ocean gate that blocked global advance through 21 Feb is CLOSED.

historical_anchors: Eastern Fleet war diary: 15-21 Feb escort shortage restricts heavy-ship sea training; Gambia arrives 20 Feb; Tromp sails 21 Feb; Operation SLEUTH sails 22 Feb.
Operation SLEUTH objective: search for suspected German blockade runners southwest of Cocos Island.
